create_dataset: create a dataset by calling CreateDataset with an options object specifying the audioVisual model
build_data_loader: build a CustomDatasetDataLoader instance initialized with training or validation mode options
load_data: load data by calling load_data on a CustomDatasetDataLoader to return the loader instance
iterate_data: iterate over dataset batches using the CustomDatasetDataLoader iterator with object_collate batching
get_dataset_length: get the dataset length by calling len on a CustomDatasetDataLoader instance
